title: fix(app-shell): Studio publish with nothing to publish is an outline that says why; measure canvas width and nav accessible name (objectui#8219)
body:
Part of #8219

This PR delivers item 2 (the publish button). It measures items 1 and 4 on a live render and records them; neither reproduced as the card describes, so nothing changes there. Item 3 (the AI panel's discussing line) is left open, and the card stays open: that line is rendered outside the claimed file (see "Item 3" below). The breadcrumb and canvas-caption tooltips are untouched, per the objectui#7254 ruling.

## How it was measured (live render)

The card's numbers came from a stack that had already exited, so every number below was re-measured in a real browser. This PR adds no backend: a dev-only Vite page in `apps/console` (uncommitted, deleted after the run) mounted the real `StudioDesignSurface` from workspace `src`. Tailwind is real, and a fetch stub answered `/api/v1/*`. The app nav was one labelled dashboard leaf (`客户仪表盘`) plus one unlabelled object leaf (`b2r4_customer`). The dashboard had one bar widget with three bars. Chromium came from `/opt/pw-browsers/chromium`.

## Item 1: canvas width (measured, not reproduced as "frames eat 55%"; no change)

Rendered width of each box, preview column to chart, at viewport 800 (main column 592, close to the card's 596):

| box | width |
| --- | --- |
| `main` (p-4) | 592 |
| Studio canvas wrapper (`rounded-lg border bg-background p-4`, this file) | 560 |
| `PreviewShell` frame (border) | 526 |
| `PreviewShell` body, then the `p-3` scroller (DashboardPreview) | 524 |
| `min-w-[768px]` grid (DashboardPreview) | **768**, wider than the 500 px the scroller shows |
| widget card (half span of the 12-column grid) | 376 |
| chart svg (card `p-6`) | 326 |

At viewport 1512 with the inspector open, the same chain reads 1016, 984, 950, 948, 924 (grid), 454 (widget), 404 (chart).

The chain reproduces the card's numbers almost exactly (596, 564, 530, 528, 376, 326), but the card attributes the loss wrongly:
- the nested frames and paddings from `main` down to the grid cost 92 px of 592 (about 16 %);
- the rest comes from the widget's half span inside a grid that `DashboardPreview` pins to `min-w-[768px]`: at narrow widths the grid is wider than the visible scroller, and the lone widget still takes half of it;
- the card's own padding costs 50 px.

The claim's rule was to act only if most of the width goes to nested frames. It does not, so this PR changes nothing for item 1. The levers that would matter are the full width and content height for a lone widget, and the `min-w-[768px]` pin. They live in `packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/DashboardPreview.tsx` and the `plugin-dashboard` grid, both outside this claim's file surface. The report hands them back to the seat as a fork.

## Item 2: the publish button (fixed)

Before: with no draft, the button is disabled but keeps `bg-primary text-primary-foreground disabled:opacity-50`, and its reason sits in `title` only. After:
- With no draft, the button is an outline (`border text-muted-foreground`). The existing `engine.studio.publishNoneTitle` string (「没有待发布的草稿」) shows as visible text beside it, and `aria-describedby` points at that text. No new i18n key.
- With a pending draft, the button is the primary button, as before. Both states carry a border (transparent on the primary) so the swap does not shift the bar.
- A read-only package also gets the outline. Its existing Read-only badge already says why on the page.

## Item 3: the AI panel's 「正在讨论：…」 line (not changed; outside the claimed file)

The line is built in `packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx`, where the `surfaceContextLabel` prop's target is `type · name`. It is rendered by `packages/plugin-chatbot/src/ChatbotEnhanced.tsx`, which has no `title` slot for the chip. The surface context carries only `{ type, name }`, taken from the URL, so it has no label to show. Neither file is in this claim's file surface, so the dev stopped on this item, as the claim requires. Options are in the report.

## Item 4: the nav item's accessible name (measured; already reads the label; pinned, no change)

Measured from the live Chromium accessibility tree (CDP `Accessibility.getFullAXTree`):
- labelled leaf: name 「客户仪表盘 仪表板」 (label plus translated kind), description `dashboard · customer_dashboard` (from `title`);
- unlabelled leaf: name 「b2r4_customer 对象」 (the internal-name fallback from objectui#7254, plus kind), description `object · b2r4_customer`.

In neither case is the name the `type · name` machine id. The id is only the description, which is what the card asks for. `getByRole('button', { name })` in jsdom gives the same result. Both pins confirm existing behaviour.

## Red, then green

- First commit (pins only, against the unfixed surface): `Tests 1 failed | 3 passed (4)`. The failure is the no-draft pin: `expected 'inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 roun…' not to match /\bbg-primary\b/`. The enabled-publish pin and both accessible-name pins pass, because they confirm existing behaviour.
- After the fix: that file plus `StudioDesignSurface.surfaceIdentity.test.tsx` (unmodified): `Test Files 2 passed (2) · Tests 8 passed (8)`.

## Gates (local, at head `d5103666da` unless stated)

- `vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/ packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/`: `Test Files 371 passed (371) · Tests 3881 passed | 1 skipped`. This ran at `da06d7bbce`; the later commit adds only the changeset. The full app-shell package was not run locally, because this run alone took 598 s under the shared lock, against the foreground cap of about 10 minutes. CI runs the full package.
- `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`: 28/28 tasks OK. `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check`: exit 0. It runs `tsc --noEmit` and `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, and `--listFilesOnly` shows the new test file is in the second project.
- eslint on the two changed source files: 0 errors, 18 warnings. `origin/main`'s copy of `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` reads the same 0 errors and 18 warnings, and none are in the changed hunks. This is a narrowed lint run: the files come from the diff, the count from eslint's `--format json`, and `eslint.config.js` enables no type-aware parser options, so the diff cannot change the verdict for any untouched file. The repo-wide `pnpm lint` is left to CI.
- `check:changeset-claims` exit 0. Its one finding (a pending changeset about eager chunks that names this file) still holds, since no import changed. `check:pending-changeset-literals` exit 0. `check:new-line-citations`: 0 new citations. `check:control-bytes` OK. `check:i18n-keys` exit 0 (no keys changed). `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: one changeset declared.
- Machine-locale census, `packages/i18n/src/__tests__/machineLocaleCensus-9909.test.ts`: passed (in a run of 3 files and 15 tests).
